newsitem.title: USA: Phillips first Bohai Bay well a dry hole.
newsitem.headline: Phillips first Bohai Bay well a dry hole.

text.p: Phillips Petroleum Co said Monday Phillips China Inc has plugged and abandoned its first exploratory well in China's Bohai Bay after the well tested hydrocarbons at non-commercial rates.

The Bozhong No. 1 well was started in June and drilled to a total depth of 14,105 feet in 85 feet of water, the company said. The well was drilled in the southwest sector of the Bozhong Block in the Gulf of Bohai, 150 miles east of Beijing.
"The well provided excellent giological information that will prove useful in our continuing exploration program in Bohai Bay," the company said.
"Phillips plans to acquire additional seismic data and drill two additional exploratory wells later in 1997," it added. ((-- New York Newsdesk 212-859-1610.))
